subject: autoid: reserve a table ID range for downstream fork (#62157)
summary: Adds `autoid.ReservedTablesBaseID` (system-flagged low bits = 5000) and tightens `TestSystemSchemaID` to keep `information_schema` system table IDs < 5000, reserving [5000,10000) for downstream forks. No runtime DDL/metadata behavior changes and no Blocker/High issues found; upstream/master retains the same constants and test.
